title: Seed
description: Rows of data for one target: an entity, a relation, a reference type or a table.

rationale.description: Markdown text: why the element is shaped this way.

decision.description: A URL or a reference (such as ADR-0042) of the decision record. It is not an element id and is not checked.

excludeStereotypes.description: Stereotype keys that a database schema's or a package's defaultStereotypes would give this element, left out with the stereotypes they imply. Only defaults can be excluded (MQ2029).

target.description: The entity, relation or reference type the rows are for; the seed belongs to it.

columns.description: Built-in keywords (code, label, description) for a reference type; column ids and foreign-key ids for a table (an inherited column or foreign key by its keyed id, <tableId>.<memberId>); else attribute or relation-end ids. A foreign-key entry stands for the key's own columns, which are then not listed: its cell names the referenced row by that table's row key, a value for a one-column key and an array in key order for a composite key.

anyOf.description: The keyed id of a column or foreign key a table target inherits from a stereotype: the table's id and the stereotype member's id joined by '.'.

key.description: A table seed's row key: the id of the unique constraint whose columns find a row again on the next run (an inherited one by its keyed id, <tableId>.<memberId>); absent, the primary key.

environments.description: The environments the rows belong to (free names such as dev, test, staging); empty means every environment.

apply.description: How the rows are applied: once inserts the rows whose key is missing and never updates or deletes; converge also updates changed rows.

delete.description: With converge: whether a row removed from the seed is deleted from the database.

rowsFrom.description: Where the rows come from instead of rows: a CSV file beside the seed file (file: a header of @id and the column ids, one row per line), or a rows script under extensions/ (script: seeds/<name>.js, which calls maquettiste.rows(fn) once and computes the rows from the model when something reads them).

script.description: The rows script, a path under extensions/: seeds/<name>.js.

values.description: One cell per column, in column order; trailing nulls are dropped.

items.description: A cell: a JSON literal of the column's type, an enum member name, a reference code or an array of codes, a row id for an end, an object for a value object, the referenced row's key for a foreign-key entry (a value, or an array for a composite key), or null.
